example_sentences.de: Ich muss morgen zum Amt gehen.
example_sentences.en: I have to go to the public office tomorrow.

example_sentences.de: Welches Amt ist dafür zuständig?
example_sentences.en: Which office is responsible for that?

cloze.de: Das ___ ist nur bis 15 Uhr geöffnet.
cloze.en: The office is only open until 3 pm.

words.notes: Appears at the end of dozens of compound words: Einwohnermeldeamt, Finanzamt, Standesamt, Jugendamt.
words.germany_context: German offices close remarkably early — often 12:00 on Fridays. Check the Öffnungszeiten before you travel across town.

example_sentences.de: Die Behörde hat meinen Antrag abgelehnt.
example_sentences.en: The authority rejected my application.

example_sentences.de: Er arbeitet bei einer Behörde.
example_sentences.en: He works for a government agency.

cloze.en: The responsible authority is reviewing the application.

words.notes: -e ending, feminine. More formal and more abstract than 'Amt'.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe einen Termin im Bürgeramt.
example_sentences.en: I have an appointment at the citizens' office.

example_sentences.de: Das Bürgeramt ist im Rathaus.
example_sentences.en: The citizens' office is in the town hall.

cloze.en: You do the registration at the citizens' office.

words.germany_context: This is where you do your Anmeldung, get a Meldebescheinigung and apply for a Personalausweis. Appointments are booked online and can be gone weeks ahead — check the site early in the morning, when cancellations appear.

example_sentences.de: Die Anmeldung dauert nur zehn Minuten.
example_sentences.en: The registration only takes ten minutes.

example_sentences.de: Ohne Anmeldung bekommen Sie keine Steuer-ID.
example_sentences.en: Without registration you won't get a tax ID.

cloze.de: Für die ___ brauchen Sie Ihren Pass.
cloze.en: For the registration you need your passport.

words.notes: -ung ending, so it is always die.
words.germany_context: You must register your address within 14 days of moving in. Almost everything else depends on it: your tax ID, a bank account, a phone contract, health insurance. Do this first.

example_sentences.de: Die Bank will eine Meldebescheinigung sehen.
example_sentences.en: The bank wants to see a certificate of registration.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe die Meldebescheinigung sofort bekommen.
example_sentences.en: I got the certificate of registration straight away.

cloze.de: Für das Konto brauchen Sie eine ___.
cloze.en: For the account you need a certificate of registration.

words.germany_context: You get this on the spot when you do your Anmeldung. Keep several copies — banks, employers and insurers all ask for it.

example_sentences.de: Können wir einen Termin vereinbaren?
example_sentences.en: Can we arrange an appointment?

example_sentences.de: Wir haben einen Preis vereinbart.
example_sentences.en: We agreed on a price.

cloze.en: I'd like to arrange an appointment.

words.notes: Inseparable — the ver- prefix never detaches, and there is no ge- in the participle: 'hat vereinbart'.

example_sentences.de: Ziehen Sie bitte eine Wartenummer.
example_sentences.en: Please take a queue number.

example_sentences.de: Meine Wartenummer ist B42.
example_sentences.en: My queue number is B42.

cloze.en: Take a queue number at the entrance.

words.germany_context: Take a number as soon as you walk in, then watch the screen — your number appears next to a Schalter (counter) number.

example_sentences.de: Bitte gehen Sie zu Schalter drei.
example_sentences.en: Please go to counter three.

example_sentences.de: Der Schalter ist geschlossen.
example_sentences.en: The counter is closed.

cloze.en: Your number is being called at counter 5.

words.notes: -er ending, masculine. Also means a light switch.

example_sentences.de: Bitte füllen Sie dieses Formular aus.
example_sentences.en: Please fill in this form.

example_sentences.de: Das Formular gibt es auch online.
example_sentences.en: The form is also available online.

cloze.en: Can you help me with the form?

words.germany_context: German forms are long and unforgiving. Bring a black pen — many offices refuse blue or pencil.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe einen Antrag auf Kindergeld gestellt.
example_sentences.en: I submitted an application for child benefit.

example_sentences.de: Der Antrag wurde bearbeitet.
example_sentences.en: The application has been processed.

cloze.de: Der ___ auf Verlängerung dauert vier Wochen.
cloze.en: The application for an extension takes four weeks.

words.notes: The set phrase is 'einen Antrag stellen' — to submit an application, literally 'to place' one.

example_sentences.de: Der Bescheid kommt per Post.
example_sentences.en: The decision comes by post.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe einen positiven Bescheid bekommen.
example_sentences.en: I received a positive decision.

cloze.de: Warten Sie bitte auf den schriftlichen ___.
cloze.en: Please wait for the written decision.

words.notes: Also in the very common idiom 'Bescheid sagen' — to let someone know.
words.germany_context: German authorities answer by paper letter, not email. Check your Briefkasten and make sure your surname is on it, or letters get returned.

example_sentences.de: Ich brauche eine Bescheinigung vom Arbeitgeber.
example_sentences.en: I need a certificate from my employer.

example_sentences.de: Bringen Sie bitte die Bescheinigung mit.
example_sentences.en: Please bring the certificate with you.

cloze.en: Can you issue me a certificate?

words.notes: -ung, therefore die.

example_sentences.de: Bitte unterschreiben Sie dieses Dokument.
example_sentences.en: Please sign this document.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe alle Dokumente dabei.
example_sentences.en: I have all the documents with me.

cloze.en: Keep this document safe.

words.notes: -ment ending, so it is das.

example_sentences.de: Brauchen Sie das Original oder eine Kopie?
example_sentences.en: Do you need the original or a copy?

example_sentences.de: Ich mache schnell eine Kopie.
example_sentences.en: I'll quickly make a copy.

cloze.de: Bringen Sie bitte eine ___ Ihres Passes mit.
cloze.en: Please bring a copy of your passport.

words.notes: A 'beglaubigte Kopie' is a certified copy, stamped by an official.
words.germany_context: Offices often want the original AND a copy, and many have no copier. Photocopy everything before you go.

example_sentences.de: Bitte bringen Sie das Original mit.
example_sentences.en: Please bring the original with you.

example_sentences.de: Wir behalten das Original nicht.
example_sentences.en: We won't keep the original.

cloze.de: Kopien reichen nicht, wir brauchen das ___.
cloze.en: Copies aren't enough, we need the original.

example_sentences.de: Hier fehlt noch Ihre Unterschrift.
example_sentences.en: Your signature is still missing here.

example_sentences.de: Die Unterschrift muss mit dem Ausweis übereinstimmen.
example_sentences.en: The signature has to match the ID.

cloze.en: Without a signature the form is invalid.

example_sentences.de: Das Formular braucht noch einen Stempel.
example_sentences.en: The form still needs a stamp.

example_sentences.de: Ohne Stempel gilt das nicht.
example_sentences.en: Without a stamp it isn't valid.

cloze.en: The stamp from the office is still missing.

words.notes: Not a postage stamp — that is 'die Briefmarke'.

example_sentences.de: Ich beantrage die Verlängerung meines Visums.
example_sentences.en: I'm applying for an extension of my visa.

example_sentences.de: Die Verlängerung kostet 100 Euro.
example_sentences.en: The extension costs 100 euros.

cloze.en: The extension takes about six weeks.

words.germany_context: Apply to extend a residence permit 6-8 weeks before it expires. The Ausländerbehörde is notoriously slow.

example_sentences.de: Die Gebühr beträgt 37 Euro.
example_sentences.en: The fee is 37 euros.

example_sentences.de: Muss ich eine Gebühr bezahlen?
example_sentences.en: Do I have to pay a fee?

cloze.de: Die ___ für den Personalausweis ist 37 Euro.
cloze.en: The fee for the ID card is 37 euros.

words.germany_context: Many offices only take cash or an EC-Karte for fees — foreign credit cards are frequently refused.

example_sentences.de: Kann ich bitte Ihren Personalausweis sehen?
example_sentences.en: May I see your ID card, please?

example_sentences.de: Mein Personalausweis ist abgelaufen.
example_sentences.en: My ID card has expired.

cloze.en: Please show me your ID card.

words.notes: Often shortened to 'Ausweis' in speech.
words.germany_context: German residents are legally required to carry ID. As a non-EU resident, carry your passport and Aufenthaltstitel.

example_sentences.de: Meine Aufenthaltserlaubnis gilt drei Jahre.
example_sentences.en: My residence permit is valid for three years.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe die Aufenthaltserlaubnis beantragt.
example_sentences.en: I applied for the residence permit.

cloze.en: The residence permit has to be renewed in good time.

words.germany_context: Issued by the Ausländerbehörde. For skilled workers the Blaue Karte EU is usually faster and leads to permanent residence sooner.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe einen Termin bei der Ausländerbehörde.
example_sentences.en: I have an appointment at the immigration office.

example_sentences.de: Die Ausländerbehörde hat sich noch nicht gemeldet.
example_sentences.en: The immigration office hasn't been in touch yet.

cloze.de: Den Aufenthaltstitel bekommen Sie bei der ___.
cloze.en: You get the residence permit from the immigration office.

words.germany_context: Waiting times of two to three months for an appointment are normal in big cities. Book the moment you know you'll need it, and bring a German-speaking friend if you can.

example_sentences.de: Das Finanzamt hat mir einen Brief geschickt.
example_sentences.en: The tax office sent me a letter.

example_sentences.de: Ich muss zum Finanzamt.
example_sentences.en: I have to go to the tax office.

cloze.en: The tax return goes to the tax office.

words.germany_context: Your Steuer-ID arrives by post a few weeks after your Anmeldung, automatically. You never apply for it.

example_sentences.de: Mein Arbeitgeber braucht meine Steueridentifikationsnummer.
example_sentences.en: My employer needs my tax ID.

example_sentences.de: Die Steuer-ID kommt automatisch per Post.
example_sentences.en: The tax ID comes automatically by post.

cloze.de: Ohne ___ bekommen Sie kein volles Gehalt.
cloze.en: Without a tax ID you won't get your full salary.

words.notes: Everyone says 'Steuer-ID' in practice.
words.germany_context: Until your employer has this number, you're taxed at the highest rate. It usually arrives 2-3 weeks after the Anmeldung — chase the Finanzamt if it doesn't.

example_sentences.de: Ich bin in Steuerklasse eins.
example_sentences.en: I'm in tax class one.

example_sentences.de: Nach der Heirat ändert sich die Steuerklasse.
example_sentences.en: After marriage the tax class changes.

cloze.en: Which tax class are you in?

words.germany_context: Six classes. Single people are class 1; married couples can split into 3 and 5 to take home more each month. Worth checking — it can be a few hundred euros a month.

example_sentences.de: Ich mache meine Steuererklärung online.
example_sentences.en: I do my tax return online.

example_sentences.de: Die Steuererklärung muss bis Juli fertig sein.
example_sentences.en: The tax return has to be done by July.

cloze.en: Have you submitted your tax return yet?

words.germany_context: Most employees get money back — the average refund is around €1,000. Tools like ELSTER (free) or WISO/Taxfix make it manageable without German.

example_sentences.de: Mein Pass läuft nächsten Monat ab.
example_sentences.en: My passport expires next month.

example_sentences.de: Die Frist ist gestern abgelaufen.
example_sentences.en: The deadline expired yesterday.

cloze.en: When does your visa expire?

words.notes: Separable, and takes sein in the Perfekt because it's a change of state. Note the stem change: du läufst, er läuft.

example_sentences.de: Ihr Antrag wird gerade bearbeitet.
example_sentences.en: Your application is currently being processed.

example_sentences.de: Wie lange dauert die Bearbeitung?
example_sentences.en: How long does processing take?

cloze.de: Der Antrag wird in vier Wochen ___.
cloze.en: The application will be processed in four weeks.

words.notes: be- prefix, inseparable, no ge- in the Perfekt.

example_sentences.de: Die Behörde hat meinen Antrag abgelehnt.
example_sentences.en: The authority rejected my application.

example_sentences.de: Er lehnt das Angebot ab.
example_sentences.en: He is turning down the offer.

cloze.en: Why was my application rejected?

words.notes: Separable — 'ab' goes to the end.

example_sentences.de: Der Antrag wurde genehmigt.
example_sentences.en: The application was approved.

example_sentences.de: Mein Chef hat den Urlaub genehmigt.
example_sentences.en: My boss approved the holiday.

cloze.en: The holiday has already been approved.

words.notes: Starts with ge- already, so the participle adds nothing: 'hat genehmigt'.

example_sentences.de: Dafür brauchen Sie eine Genehmigung.
example_sentences.en: You need a permit for that.

example_sentences.de: Die Genehmigung ist endlich da.
example_sentences.en: The permit has finally arrived.

cloze.en: Without a permit you're not allowed to work.

words.notes: -ung, therefore die.

example_sentences.de: Wir haben auf dem Standesamt geheiratet.
example_sentences.en: We got married at the registry office.

example_sentences.de: Die Geburtsurkunde bekommt man beim Standesamt.
example_sentences.en: You get the birth certificate from the registry office.

cloze.en: The marriage is registered at the registry office.

words.germany_context: Only a Standesamt marriage is legally binding in Germany — a religious ceremony has no legal effect on its own.

example_sentences.de: Bitte bringen Sie Ihre Geburtsurkunde mit.
example_sentences.en: Please bring your birth certificate.

example_sentences.de: Die Geburtsurkunde muss übersetzt werden.
example_sentences.en: The birth certificate has to be translated.

cloze.de: Für die Heirat brauchen Sie eine ___.
cloze.en: For the marriage you need a birth certificate.

words.germany_context: Foreign certificates usually need a certified German translation and sometimes an Apostille. Sort this out before you leave your home country.

example_sentences.de: Der Arbeitgeber braucht Ihre Sozialversicherungsnummer.
example_sentences.en: The employer needs your social security number.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe meine Sozialversicherungsnummer noch nicht.
example_sentences.en: I don't have my social security number yet.

cloze.en: Please state your social security number.

words.germany_context: Issued automatically once you start your first job — your health insurer arranges it. You don't apply separately.

example_sentences.de: Für diesen Job brauche ich ein Führungszeugnis.
example_sentences.en: I need a certificate of good conduct for this job.

example_sentences.de: Das Führungszeugnis beantragt man im Bürgeramt.
example_sentences.en: You apply for the certificate of good conduct at the citizens' office.

cloze.en: The employer requires a certificate of good conduct.

words.notes: -nis ending, so it is das.
words.germany_context: Required for jobs involving children, healthcare or finance. Apply at the Bürgeramt; it costs about €13 and arrives by post in 1-2 weeks.

example_sentences.de: Welche Unterlagen brauche ich für die Anmeldung?
example_sentences.en: Which documents do I need for the registration?

example_sentences.de: Welche Unterlagen soll ich mitbringen?
example_sentences.en: Which documents should I bring?

cloze.de: ___ Unterlagen brauche ich für den Termin?
cloze.en: Which documents do I need for the appointment?

words.germany_context: Ask this on every single phone call to an office. It saves entire wasted mornings.

example_sentences.de: Guten Tag, ich möchte mich anmelden.
example_sentences.en: Hello, I'd like to register.

example_sentences.de: Ich möchte mich für einen Kurs anmelden.
example_sentences.en: I'd like to register for a course.

cloze.en: Hello, I'd like to register.

words.notes: The first sentence you say at the Bürgeramt counter.
